semiconductor_relevance: High — Oculi develops advanced vision sensors that integrate sensing and processing capabilities, which are critical for AI applications in semiconductor technology.
summary: Oculi specializes in edge AI vision technology with its Software Defined Vision Sensors™, which significantly enhance the efficiency of visual data processing. Their OCULI Sensor & Processing Unit (SPU) architecture allows for real-time intelligence with reduced power consumption and latency, making it suitable for modern AI workloads.
